cuts.item: positions funded by the FY25 override

statements.statement: A board member said the school committee revealed an approximate surplus at its September 3rd meeting.
The superintendent's memo reported this figure as the budget surplus; the town manager said it should not be treated as certain.
The books currently show this amount as an encumbrance, which could represent real outstanding bills that would shrink the surplus.
The town manager said the true outstanding-bills figure is somewhere in that range, which would reduce the surplus by that much.
Any school surplus must revert to the town and become free cash, appropriable only at town meeting, no earlier than November 18th 2025.
The town manager confirmed that FY25 override-funded positions were restored and Chromebooks were purchased as planned.
The district is reviewing whether the assumptions behind the FY25 numbers were also built into the FY26 budget, a process expected to take months.
